# v0.1.24 preview

This artifact is a preview. It does not claim equivalence with other hosted
workflow services.

The version string is 0.1.24. The capability version is 12.

The poll upgrades saved branch and pull-request validators that predate
pagination by reading every page once and saving the paging record.

Poll submissions now keep durable lifecycle states. A capability refusal blocks until the worker engine identity changes, and a tested-commit mismatch blocks until an operator retries or abandons it. The poll command exposes inspect, repair, retry, and abandon recovery, and abandon reasons are retained.

Retries now check out the tested commit before submitting, and the worker refuses a push or pull-request submission when repository HEAD does not match the tested commit. Mismatched submissions remain inspectable and can be retired with an error status.

Commit trust checks request one file record rather than the full file list.
This keeps large commit responses within the poller's API body limit while
preserving author, committer, and signature validation.

The wheel and the source tarball can be built from this tree. They are not
published. This change does not create a tag.

The project license is the MIT License.

No credentials are included in the artifact.
